authoredNote: Source written first from the pre-declared contract (an anonymous type may never be the file's primary top-level type); the expectation records the post-ruling run's spelling. This is a SECOND defect class the #867 corpus sweep exposed — it was not in the issue, and it is measured, not assumed: kotlinx-coroutines/reactor/Flux.kt had 8 import edges attributed to anonymous_Subscription (owner=-) before the ruling.
rationale: M49/M37 #867 follow-on, UPDATED by the M14 ontology wave (DERIV_OVERRIDES). Import references are emitted with the placeholder source `root` and then rewritten onto the file's primary top-level TYPE — a search that accepted any ownerless class/interface/enum symbol. Before the #867 ruling a top-level function's anonymous object had NO owner, so it qualified and claimed the whole file's imports. That half is unchanged and still pinned. The SECOND half changed: this file has no top-level class, and the pre-wave answer was to leave the literal `root` in a name-bearing field. Measured on a 200-file corpus draw, 302 relationship endpoints carried that literal — rule R7's runtime half, which validation/m60/symbol-sentinel-register.json records as outstanding project-wide. The rewrite now falls back to the compilation unit's own file name (`anon-type-not-file-primary-type`), which is a real identity. The DEFECT the fixture exists to catch is unchanged and is now pinned from both directions: a forbid on the anonymous type AND a forbid on the placeholder, so neither the pre-ruling attribution nor the pre-wave literal can come back.

expectSymbols.name: anonymous_Runnable
expectSymbols.comment: #867: a top-level function's literal is owned by that function

expectRelationships.comment: no top-level class exists, so the import reference falls back to the compilation unit's own file name (M14 ontology wave) rather than the `root` placeholder literal; the anon type must still not take it

forbidRelationships.comment: #867 the measured pre-ruling defect: the anonymous type claimed the file's import edge (Flux.kt x8)
R7: `root` is a placeholder literal in a name-bearing field. The fallback is the file's own name, so this row must never reappear.
